entries.title: The crew ring shows each crewmate as it is after a reconnect
entries.body: When the window reconnected to the Mac it controls, a crewmate on the ring could keep looking busy or idle as it was before the gap until its next change. A crewmate whose task became active again while it was leaving the ring could also vanish. The ring now takes each crewmate's current look when it reconnects, and a crewmate that comes back stays.
entries.noPicture: The ring looks the same; the fix only makes it match the record after a reconnect.
